newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Banco Itau buys Banerj for 311.1 mln reais.
newsitem.headline: Banco Itau buys Banerj for 311.1 mln reais.

text.p: Brazilian private bank Banco Itau bought Rio de Janeiro state bank Banerj for 311.1 million reais in a closed-envelope privatization auction Thursday, the Rio de Janeiro Stock Exchange said.
The price paid by Banco Itau, Brazil's second largest private bank, was slightly higher than the minimum price of 310 million reais.
Bradesco, BCN and Cia. de Investimentos Latino-Americana, owned by a foreign bank and represented by local Banco Pactual, had been expected to bid, but only Itau presented a proposal to buy the bank.

The Banerj sale, the first of a Brazilian state bank, was originally slated to take place last week. The auction was put on hold pending Senate approval of a 3.09 billion reais loan to Rio state to cover the bank's pension and payroll-related debts.
A solution for those debts was key to making the bank salable

Also to make Banerj appealing to investors, Rio state cut the bank's base price to 310 million reais from 480 million reais. The original base price was set last year when previous attempts to sell the bank were held up by legal challenges and debt concerns.
Itau acquired 99.97 percent of Banerj, a bank with 4.5 billion reais in assets, 193 branches and a net worth of 181 million reais.
((--Simona de Logu, Rio de Janeiro Newsroom 5511 2485412))
